Take your career to the next level with our
***On-the-Job Trainee Program***
!

Our program offers real-world experience to those seeking to explore or acquire the relevant knowledge and skills necessary to enter the Software Development Industry, by working closely with our professional colleagues in a live-work practice environment. You will receive mentoring from our experienced colleagues through our Software Engineering Trainee Program. Still, we will also design your program in tandem with you, in a way that resonates with your interests and skills.

***What are we looking for:***

* Having Technical Studies: currently pursuing or a graduate of a Bachelor's Degree and/or a Master's Degree
* Fundamental concepts of programming (e.g., OOP, algorithmics, databases)
* Adaptability to new programming languages, platforms, and frameworks
* Passion for AI field and willingness to further improve your related skills
* Learning and growth focus: having extracurricular activities such as courses, GitHub Portofolio, extracurricular projects
* Considered a plus: previous internship experience
* Looking to be part of a result-oriented team
* Being comfortable with English – advanced level

***What we offer:***

* Technical and soft skills training & workshops
* Experienced mentors to guide and inspire you
* Work in a best practice-driven environment
* Flexible work schedule

**Work policy:**
On-site (including evaluation steps: written test, interviews)

**Employment type:**
full-time

**Deadline for application:**
The program is active throughout the year, and we are constantly looking for talented colleagues.

**Process:**
CV screening, on-site test, HR & Technical interviews.

**A new adventure awaits! Let's step into the future together!**

*\*Please note that only selected candidates will be contacted.*

*\*\*Please note that by applying to this role you are informed about your personal data being processed by Yonder for this role and for future ones.*
